# morpheus-cli

**Tag**: cli, devops

## 简介

Infrastructure agnostic cloud application management & orchestration CLI for Morpheus. Easily manage and orchestrate VMS on private or public infrastructure and containerized architectures.

## 官网

- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/morpheus-cli/9.0.2
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/morpheus-cli
